published_ranges._ams: Creality TPU tip (shared by CR-TPU/HP-TPU on its filament type page): printers should use a direct-drive extruder; Shore hardness not published, so AMS suitability unknown.
published_ranges._notes: Creality filament parameter reference table (2024-12-23): recommended 210C nozzle, 50C bed, 50 mm/s. K2 Plus table: 220C/40C, 3 mm3/s (printer profile values).
